# Runix

> Runix builds tools that make AI effortless to use. Its flagship, Runix Router,
> is an LLM router: one OpenAI-compatible API in front of many model providers,
> with routing, automatic failover, central key custody, per-key quotas and
> per-request cost attribution. Operated by Runix AI Inc, a company incorporated
> in Wyoming, United States. The service is in early access — keys are issued on
> request rather than through self-serve signup.

## Products

Products at different stages. The statuses below are literal.

- **Runix Router** — *status: early access, running traffic today.* One OpenAI-compatible
  endpoint across many providers, positioned on security, compliance and performance:
  central key custody, per-key limits and quotas, request-level audit trail, contracts and
  written data terms, automatic failover between providers with streaming preserved, and
  routing by cost, health and configuration. Hosted API, billed on usage.
  https://runixcloud.io/router
- **Runix Pipeline** — *status: in development with design partners.* Managed data
  preparation for AI: ingestion, cleaning, three tiers of deduplication, schema-validated
  LLM extraction, PII masking that fails closed, and a quality report with every delivery.
  Scoped and priced per project or volume. https://runixcloud.io/pipeline
- **Runix Code** — *status: in development, waitlist open.* An AI coding agent being built
  for teams: codebase-aware completion and chat, agentic multi-file tasks that land as
  reviewable diffs, and team controls (seats, usage attribution, model routing policies,
  written data terms). Not generally available. https://runixcloud.io/code
- **Runix Comic** — *status: in development, waitlist open.* An end-to-end AI studio for
  comic dramas being built to cover pre-production (scripts, consistent characters,
  storyboards), production (styled panels, motion, voice-over, subtitles) and publishing
  (export, multi-platform distribution, promotional assets). Not generally available.
  https://runixcloud.io/comic

## Facts a buyer usually asks for

- Legal entity: Runix AI Inc, Wyoming, United States.
- Contracting: MSA and DPA on request, reviewed per engagement; an order form takes
  precedence over the standard Terms.
- Billing: USD, usage-based (per token or per request, by model), itemised statements,
  prepaid draw-down or invoiced. There is no published rate card; quotes are per workload.
- Data handling: customer prompt and response content is not used to train models and is
  not sold. Operational metadata (usage counts, latency, error codes) is kept to run
  billing, reliability and support. Details in the Privacy Policy and Security page.
- Certifications: none are claimed. Runix does not assert SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI status.
- Support: replies within one business day, contact@runixcloud.io.

## Selected writing

- [Model Failover for Production LLM Traffic](https://runixcloud.io/blog/model-failover):
  failure taxonomy, retry budgets, circuit breakers, degradation tiers.
- [LLM Cost Control: Tokens, Caching and Budgets](https://runixcloud.io/blog/llm-cost-control):
  token pricing asymmetry, prompt caching, routing, budget enforcement.
- [Choosing an LLM Gateway: 7 Things That Matter](https://runixcloud.io/blog/llm-gateway-guide):
  how to evaluate gateways on compatibility, failover, cost attribution and operational burden.
- [Building AI Data Pipelines: Raw to Model-Ready](https://runixcloud.io/blog/ai-data-pipelines):
  ingestion, deduplication tiers, LLM extraction with schema validation, PII masking.
